WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN s.GSserved LIKE 'P-%' THEN 0
      WHEN s.GSserved LIKE 'K-%' THEN 1
      WHEN s.GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*-*'
        THEN CAST(substr(s.GSserved, 1, instr(s.GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) + 2
      WHEN s.GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*'
        THEN CAST(s.GSserved AS INTEGER) + 2
      ELSE 99
    END AS start_grade
  FROM schools AS s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND s.GSserved <> ''
    AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) = 12
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM satscores AS x
      WHERE x.cds = s.CDSCode
        AND x.NumTstTakr > 0
    )
),
first_grade AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_grade) AS start_grade
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT c.School, c.GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM candidates AS c
JOIN first_grade AS f ON c.start_grade = f.start_grade
ORDER BY c.School;

WITH latest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX("Academic Year") AS academic_year
  FROM frpm
),
funding_types AS (
  SELECT 'Directly funded' AS funding_type, 'Directly funded' AS school_funding
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Locally funded only', 'Locally funded'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT
    ft.funding_type,
    s.CDSCode,
    s.StatusType,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_k12
  FROM funding_types AS ft
  JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.FundingType = ft.school_funding
  JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  JOIN latest_year AS y
    ON f."Academic Year" = y.academic_year
  WHERE s.Charter = 1
    AND s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education'
)
SELECT
  ft.funding_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.StatusType = 'Active' THEN c.CDSCode END)
    AS currently_operating_schools,
  COALESCE(SUM(c.enrollment_k12), 0) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  COALESCE(SUM(c.frpm_k12), 0) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM funding_types AS ft
LEFT JOIN cohort AS c
  ON c.funding_type = ft.funding_type
GROUP BY ft.funding_type
ORDER BY CASE ft.funding_type
  WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END;

          ELSE 0
        END
      ) = 0 THEN 'No SAT Data'
      WHEN AVG(

           AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL

      WHEN AVG(

           AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL

    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.overall_rating,
    pa.defensive_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
      ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
  WHERE date(pa.date) <= '2013-07-12'
),
selected AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating
  FROM latest_on_date
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND LOWER(TRIM(defensive_work_rate)) IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
average_rating AS (
  SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall
  FROM selected
),
donovan AS (
  SELECT s.overall_rating
  FROM selected AS s
  JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = s.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * (d.overall_rating - a.avg_overall) / a.avg_overall,
  2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM donovan AS d
CROSS JOIN average_rating AS a;

    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'D'
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district,
    ROUND((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / NULLIF(d.A12, 0), 2) AS percentage_change
FROM district AS d
JOIN branch_districts AS b ON b.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A12 IS NOT NULL

  WHERE date(a.date, 'start of month') = fm.month_start

WITH borrowing_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS opening_date,
    c.district_id AS home_district_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN disp AS dp
    ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
   AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE a.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Prachatice'
  )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan AS l
      WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
    )
),
account_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ba.account_id,
    ba.opening_date,
    ba.home_district_id,
    (
      SELECT SUM(l.amount)
      FROM loan AS l
      WHERE l.account_id = ba.account_id
    ) AS total_borrowed,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account)
      FROM trans AS t
      WHERE t.account_id = ba.account_id
        AND t.operation = 'VYBER'
        AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
        AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    ) AS outside_counterparties
  FROM borrowing_accounts AS ba
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    am.*,
    d.A8 AS home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.A8 DESC) AS population_rank
  FROM account_metrics AS am
  JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = am.home_district_id
)
SELECT
  account_id AS account_number,
  opening_date AS account_opening_date,
  total_borrowed,
  outside_counterparties,
  home_district_id,
  home_district_population,
  population_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_number ASC;

WITH borrowing_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS opening_date,
    a.district_id AS branch_district_id,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN loan AS l
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date, a.district_id
),
account_owners AS (
  SELECT
    d.account_id,
    c.district_id AS home_district_id
  FROM disp AS d
  JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_counterparties AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS outside_counterparty_count
  FROM trans AS t
  WHERE t.type = 'credit'
    AND t.operation = 'collection from another bank'
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT
  b.account_id,
  b.opening_date,
  b.total_borrowed,
  COALESCE(cp.outside_counterparty_count, 0) AS outside_counterparty_count,
  hd.A2 AS home_district,
  hd.A4 AS home_district_population,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hd.A4 DESC) AS population_rank
FROM borrowing_accounts AS b
JOIN account_owners AS o
  ON o.account_id = b.account_id
JOIN district AS branch_d
  ON branch_d.district_id = b.branch_district_id
JOIN district AS hd
  ON hd.district_id = o.home_district_id
LEFT JOIN account_counterparties AS cp
  ON cp.account_id = b.account_id
WHERE branch_d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
ORDER BY hd.A4 DESC, b.account_id ASC;

WITH account_avg AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
gold_holders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.gender,
        a.district_id,
        d.A4 AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        d.A10 AS urban_ratio
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
      ON c.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
    JOIN account_avg AS aa
      ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
      AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
      AND d.A4 > 100000
),
district_gender AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT gender, district_id, inhabitants, salary, urban_ratio
    FROM gold_holders
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants,
        ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM district_gender
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
    CASE aggregated.gender
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'women'
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'men'
        ELSE aggregated.gender
    END AS gender,
    aggregated.district_count,
    district_gender.district_id,
    district_gender.inhabitants AS highest_district_inhabitants,
    aggregated.avg_salary,
    aggregated.avg_urban_ratio
FROM aggregated
JOIN district_gender
  ON district_gender.gender = aggregated.gender
 AND district_gender.inhabitants = aggregated.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY
    CASE aggregated.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    district_gender.district_id;

WITH account_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
gold_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.gender, owner_disp.account_id
  FROM card AS ca
  JOIN disp AS card_disp ON card_disp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = card_disp.client_id
  JOIN disp AS owner_disp
    ON owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
   AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
  WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
),
districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         gh.gender,
         a.district_id,
         d.A4 AS inhabitants,
         d.A11 AS salary,
         d.A10 AS urban_ratio
  FROM gold_holders AS gh
  JOIN account_avg AS aa
    ON aa.account_id = gh.account_id
   AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = gh.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE d.A4 > 100000
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS max_inhabitants
  FROM districts
),
summary AS (
  SELECT gender,
         COUNT(*) AS district_count,
         ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
         ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
  FROM districts
  GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT s.gender,
       s.district_count,
       r.district_id AS most_inhabitant_district_id,
       r.inhabitants AS most_inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM summary AS s
JOIN ranked AS r
  ON r.gender = s.gender
 AND r.inhabitants = r.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE s.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 0 WHEN 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         r.district_id;

    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id

      ON owner.account_id = a.account_id
     AND owner.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN card AS c
      ON c.disp_id = owner.disp_id
     AND c.type = 'gold'
    WHERE d.A4 >= 250000
),
pair_totals AS (

        t.account AS recipient_counter_account_number,

    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN qualifying_accounts AS qa ON qa.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked AS (

           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM pair_totals
)
SELECT
    recipient_bank_code,
    recipient_counter_account_number,
    outgoing_payment_count,
    total_amount_paid
FROM ranked
WHERE amount_rank = 1
ORDER BY recipient_bank_code, recipient_counter_account_number;

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(t.bank) <> ''

        END) AS external_counterparty_count
    FROM trans t

    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),

        COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,

        COALESCE(tt.external_counterparty_count, 0) AS external_counterparty_count
    FROM gold_card_accounts g
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
    JOIN district ON district.district_id = a.district_id

    LEFT JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.account_id = g.account_id
)

    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_received,
    total_withdrawn,
    loan_count,

    AND c.country = 'France'
    AND r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT e.raceId, e.date, d.forename, d.surname,
         MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms

qualifying_rows AS (
  SELECT raceId, date, forename, surname, fastest_ms

         WHEN fastest_ms IS NOT NULL

           fastest_ms % 1000

           + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds_after_midnight
  FROM races AS r

),

  FROM race_times AS rt
  CROSS JOIN extrema AS e
  WHERE rt.seconds_after_midnight = e.earliest_seconds

  UNION ALL

  SELECT DISTINCT
         'latest' AS endpoint,
         rt.circuitRef,
         e.latest_seconds AS seconds_after_midnight,
         e.latest_seconds - e.earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
  FROM race_times AS rt

  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
patient_groups AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.Admission AS care_setting,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
          WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END AS age
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN low_rbc_patients AS r ON r.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
  care_setting,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
  ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM patient_groups
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY CASE care_setting WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

WITH bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.atom_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY c.atom_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.atom_id2 AS atom_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY c.atom_id2
),
atom_bond_totals AS (
    SELECT
        atom_id,
        SUM(total_bonds) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(single_bonds) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(multiple_bonds) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond_counts
    GROUP BY atom_id
)
SELECT
    a.element AS element_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN atom_bond_totals AS t ON t.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE t.total_bonds > 0
  AND t.single_bonds = t.total_bonds
  AND t.multiple_bonds = 0
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
